g.text: Asking and not buying, by request type and name group

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Share of runs where the agent asked the buyer a question (top) or did not complete a purchase (bottom).
Pilot preview: built only to test the figure code, not a finding.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Exploratory. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names; a cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints
its pooled count (also when that value is not 0). No purchase includes refusals, errors, invalid product IDs and no tool call. In vague requests
the agent could ask twice before a scripted 'choose one yourself' reply; second-ask rates are in the CSV. Each row shares one scale. n under
each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Color = name group, the same in every figure.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
